% Pattern: proof/attach/paragraph-head. The proofs of an appendix come after
% other statements, each under a paragraph head that names its lemma by the
% number and not by a reference.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 2 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-2
% want proof-2 proof - proves=lemma-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}
A statement.
\end{lemma}
Some text between them.

\section{Appendix}
\begin{lemma}
A helper.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A step.
\end{proof}

\paragraph{Proof of Lemma 1}
\begin{proof}
By the helper.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
